test_case.test_name: HEVC profile/tier/bit-depth hardware decode integrity and physical display
test_case.purpose: Validate the approved HEVC stream's exact profile/tier/level and coding features are hardware-decoded on the bound GPU with correct picture order and reconstructed pixels, then physically displayed without defects, independently from encoding.
required_package: Immutable HEVC input and SHA-256 with container/Annex-B, VPS/SPS/PPS, profile/tier/level, bit depth/chroma, dimensions, color/HDR, CTU/tile/WPP, reference/reorder, rate/time base and frame expectations
Golden display-order `framemd5`, expected PTS/DTS and pinned output pixel/tone-map policy
Exact GPU serial/UUID/BDF, driver/VBIOS and ffmpeg/ffprobe build with positive HEVC capability and verbose NVDEC no-fallback evidence
Bounded scratch/evidence root; approved connector/display/HDR mode/player/capture route and qualified operator
Health/event thresholds, abort criteria and non-destructive recovery
test_case.test_command: PARAMETERIZED REVIEW-LAYER PROCEDURE — do not execute until approved. Verify HEVC input/golden hashes, scratch capacity, exact GPU profile/bit-depth capability and baseline without clearing logs. Record `ffprobe -v error -show_streams -show_format -show_frames -select_streams v:0 -of json "$HEVC_INPUT"`; require approved profile/tier/level, parameter sets, bit depth/chroma, color/HDR, coding features, frame types and PTS/DTS. Record ffmpeg build/hardware capability. Run `ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel repeat+level+verbose -hwaccel "$APPROVED_HWACCEL" -hwaccel_device "$GPU_SELECTOR" -i "$HEVC_INPUT" -map 0:v:0 -an -vf "$APPROVED_HW_DOWNLOAD_PIXEL_FORMAT_AND_COLOR_POLICY" -f framemd5 "$HEVC_ACTUAL_FRAMEMD5"`; require exact NVDEC/no fallback and golden/display-order equality. Play the complete same stream using the approved connector/display mode, collect time-correlated visual evidence and final health/events. Stop on anomaly; do not retry.
test_case.expected_result: HEVC hashes and profile/tier/level/VPS-SPS-PPS/bit-depth/chroma/color/coding metadata match; exact GPU capability and hardware decoder are proven without fallback; all display-order frames, timestamps and signatures match and ffmpeg exits 0 without parser/decode error. Complete physical playback has no corruption, wrong reorder, banding beyond reference, color/HDR error, freeze, tearing, crop/aspect or edge artifact; health remains acceptable.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires every HEVC capability, parameter-set/picture-order, signature, health and visual check. FAIL on encode-evidence substitution, unsupported required tier/profile/bit depth/chroma, fallback, parameter-set/parser error, frame/timestamp/signature mismatch, truncated playback, visual/color defect, nonzero exit or health breach. BLOCKED at runtime when bindings are absent. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Reject raw-input `-c:v hevc`, H.265/HEVC Encode results and software fallback as decoder evidence.
Verify immutable media/golden and exact profile/tier/bit-depth/color contract plus device capability before workload.
Use bounded approved scratch only, preserve logs/events and uniquely tag decoder artifacts.
Keep reconstructed-frame comparison distinct from connector-bound visual/HDR evidence.
Stop on media/parser/decoder/GPU/thermal/storage/display/evidence anomaly; no retry, reset, reboot, log clear or firmware change.
expected_evidence: Exact GPU/driver/VBIOS/ffmpeg identity, positive HEVC capability, selected NVDEC path and no-fallback log
Complete parser/decode log, exit status, picture/timestamp accounting and exact `framemd5` comparison
Connector/display/HDR mode/player identity and full-clip time-correlated qualified visual record
Decode-only tags, encode non-reuse audit, scratch/health/events, no-retry audit and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop decoder/player on first parser, reconstruction, visual or health failure; preserve decode-only media, manifests, logs, captures and events and do not retry. Remove only approved scratch after retention; restore approved display/session state without reset, reboot or firmware action and escalate if health remains abnormal.
